cards.title: Widget resolution
items: Enabled dashboard_widgets rows matching entity + dashboard_name + name win; with none, the registry defaults render (landing pages take only the first 4)
Rows whose widget_name isn't in the registry are skipped; tag_list filters against owner tags (e.g. Fund category) or the user's role tags
acts_as_list positions order the grid; metadata is a safe-eval'd Ruby hash passed to the partial as args (metadata_help documents each widget's options)

cards.title: The 9 dashboard types
items: FM / LP / Ops Landing Pages, Fund, Ops, Investor, Portfolio, Aggregated Portfolio, and Portfolio Company
Each entity can keep several named variants per type (name column, default "Default"); resolve_dashboard orders the dropdown by the user's dashboard_sequence preference
DashboardWidgetsController provides the CRUD, Ransack search, and a turbo-stream metadata_help preview

cards.title: Portfolio Company Dashboard
items: Widget-based page whose owner is the portfolio company: KPI grids, budget-vs-actual, key numbers, valuations, captable, value bridge, portfolio investments & stats, documents, notes
Its AI widgets — Scoring Report (PortfolioScoringAgent), Agent Chart, Presentation Analyst, Note Summaries — render SupportAgentReports content

The standalone compliance dashboard (PortfolioCompanyDashboardController) is separate: PortfolioCompanyAgent runs via PortfolioValidationJob, with stat cards, look-back window status, and reminder sending
